name: m1_canvas_tools
description: M1 canvas slice, starting from the RTL's boot circuit (columns 2-5, rows 2-7): every canvas tool once (wire, junction, elbow, tee, ground, R, L, C, V, I), blocked placements, rotate (click, hold, blocked, boot parts), delete (click, component half, boot component, drag), smallest-free-slot reuse, pan with clamping and drawing while panned. Grid coordinates are (column, row); pan 0 shows rows 0-8.
steps: # Every checkpoint is preceded by 'wait 2' so a small RTL input-to-effect latency (RTL-3) still lands before it.
# Let the design boot (init delay, canvas clear, boot circuit) before any input.
# Wire family. Clicking the wire button while it is selected cycles wire -> junction -> elbow -> tee (A-007).
# Two-cell components, placed at rotation 0 (second cell to the right). Boot components hold slots 0-2.
# Blocked placements: onto a right half, overlapping an anchor, past the right edge, onto a boot wire cell.
# Rotate: a wire, a component through its right half, a held press (repeats every 8 frames), a blocked rotation, boot parts.
# Delete: a wire cell, a component through its right half, a boot component, then slot reuse (smallest free slot).
# Pan: drag up by 100 px, then past the limit (clamps at -224), draw while panned, pan back (clamps at 0).
